newsitem.title: USA: Group has 5.1 pct of Medco Research.
newsitem.headline: Group has 5.1 pct of Medco Research.

text.p: A group of New York private investment partnerships and their general partners said on Tuesday they acquired 534,646 common shares of Medco Research Inc, or 5.1 percent of the total outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought the stake for investment purposes in various purchases totaling $6.2 million.
Between May 12 and July 2, the group bought 44,500 shares at prices ranging from $7.820 to $9.874 each, it said.

The group consists of EGS Associates LP, EGS Partners LLC, Bev Partners LP, Pharmaceutical/Medical Technology Fund LP and general partners William Ehrman, Frederic Greenberg, Frederick Ketcher, Jonas Gerstl and James McLaren.
